Remark
[a more general Hessian criterion for a warped product]

Source: petersen:page-0171, petersen:page-0172 ↗ thm:pet-ch4-brinkmann-warped-product 1. ch4:4.7.4If $(M,g)$ has a function $f$ with $\mathrm{Hess}\, f=\lambda (x)g+\mu (f)df^2$ for $\lambda :M\to \mathbb {R}$, $\mu :\mathbb {R}\to \mathbb {R}$, show that the metric is locally a warped product.
